The Democrats’ lead over Republicans in an average of national polls on the generic congressional ballot stands at 6.4 points, the same as on August 3. The high point so far for Democrats in 2026 was a lead of 7.1 points.  

August brought Republicans some good news as gas prices leveled out. The average price for a gallon of gas today stands at $4.09, which is down a penny from last month and is substantially lower than the peak average of roughly $4.50 a gallon earlier this year.

# HMP Poll: Leela Gray LEADS Anna Paulina Luna in FL-13

September 1, 2026

Washington, D.C. – A new House Majority PAC poll of Florida’s 13th Congressional District, conducted by Hart Research Associates from August 25-27, finds Democratic candidate Leela Gray leading Republican candidate Anna Paulina Luna, 51% to 46%.

Key findings from HMP’s poll include: [...] Leela Gray leads Anna Paulina Luna in the multi-candidate ballot: In an initial multi-candidate matchup, Gray leads Luna 44% to 43%. 7% said they would support independent candidate Tony D’Arrigo.
